get.description: Get all existing users, return OK array empty if dont exist any user

post.description: Creates a new internal user account. Fails if the request data is invalid or a user with the same email already exists.

put.description: Updates name, email and role of an existing user. Fails if the user does not exist or the new email already belongs to another user.

delete.description: Deletes an existing user by id. Idempotent: returns No Content whether the user existed or not.

patch.summary: Changes the authenticated user's own password.
patch.description: Self-service password change. Requires the current password and only allows a user to change their own password.

post.description: Validates the given credentials and returns a JWT access token and a refresh token on success.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new JWT access token and a new refresh token. The given refresh token is revoked and cannot be used again.
Revokes the given refresh token. Idempotent: an unknown or already revoked refresh token also results in 204 No Content.

get.description: Returns all existing customers, an empty array if none exist.

post.description: Creates a new customer record. Fails if the request data is invalid or a customer with the same document already exists.

get.description: Returns the customer that matches the given identifier.

put.description: Updates name, email and phone of an existing customer. The document (CPF/CNPJ) cannot be changed. Fails if the customer does not exist or the new email/phone already belongs to another customer.

delete.description: Deletes an existing customer by id. Idempotent: returns No Content whether the customer existed or not. Fails if the customer has vehicles associated.

get.description: Returns all existing vehicles, an empty array if none exist.

post.description: Registers a new vehicle linked to an existing customer. Fails if the customer does not exist or the license plate already belongs to another vehicle.

get.description: Returns the vehicle that matches the given identifier.

put.description: Updates brand, model, color and model year of an existing vehicle. The license plate and manufacture year cannot be changed. Fails if the vehicle does not exist.

delete.description: Deletes an existing vehicle by id. Idempotent: returns No Content whether the vehicle existed or not. Fails if the vehicle has service orders associated.

get.description: Returns all services registered in the catalog. Returns an empty array if none exist.

post.description: Registers a new service in the catalog. Fails if a service with the same code already exists.

get.description: Returns the service that matches the given identifier.

put.description: Updates name, description, base price, estimated duration and active status of an existing service. The catalog code cannot be changed. Changing the estimated duration resets the incremental execution average (ExecutionCount back to zero). Fails if the service does not exist.

delete.description: Deletes an existing service by id. Idempotent: returns No Content whether the service existed or not. Fails if the service has ever been used in a service order.

get.description: Returns all inventory items registered in stock. Returns an empty array if none exist.

post.description: Registers a new part/supply in stock with an initial quantity on hand. Fails if an item with the same code already exists.

get.summary: Gets an inventory item by id.
get.description: Returns the inventory item that matches the given identifier.

put.description: Updates name, description, unit price, minimum stock, unit of measure and active status of an existing inventory item. The catalog code, quantity on hand and reserved quantity cannot be changed here — stock levels are only managed through the budget/approval flow. Fails if the inventory item does not exist.

delete.description: Deletes an existing inventory item by id. Idempotent: returns No Content whether the item existed or not. Fails if the item has ever been used in a service order.

get.summary: Gets the open service orders, by status priority.
get.description: Returns the service orders still in the workshop flow, including their status, budget items and status history, ordered by status (InProgress > AwaitingApproval > Diagnosing > Received > Cancelled) and then oldest first. Completed and Delivered orders are not listed. Returns an empty array if none exist.

post.description: Opens a service order for an existing vehicle owned by an existing customer. The order starts in the Received status with no budget.

get.summary: Looks up service orders for a vehicle.
get.description: Public, unauthenticated endpoint for the customer to track their vehicle's service orders. Requires both the vehicle's license plate and the owning customer's document; always returns 200 with an empty list when the plate doesn't exist or the document doesn't match its owner, so existence of a plate/document is never leaked.

get.summary: Gets a service order by id.
get.description: Returns the service order that matches the given identifier, including its status, budget items and status history.

get.summary: Gets the current status of a service order.
get.description: Returns only the current status of the service order that matches the given identifier and when it entered that status.

post.summary: Starts the diagnosis of a service order.
post.description: Registers the diagnosis description and moves the service order from Received to Diagnosing.

post.summary: Adds a budget to a service order.
post.description: Calculates the subtotal/total from the given services and parts, reserves the requested inventory stock, and moves the service order from Diagnosing to AwaitingApproval.
Registers the actual duration of every service in the order, updates the catalog's incremental average duration for each touched service, and moves the service order from InProgress to Completed.

post.summary: Delivers a service order's vehicle back to the customer.
post.description: Registers that the vehicle left the shop and closes the service order, moving it to Delivered. Accepts orders in Completed (repair finished) or Cancelled (customer rejected the budget and is picking up the vehicle without any repair).

post.summary: Receives the customer's budget decision from an external system.
post.description: Called by an external system (authenticated with the X-Api-Key header, not JWT) when the customer approves or rejects the budget of a service order in AwaitingApproval. Approved (0) commits the reserved inventory stock and moves the order to InProgress; Rejected (1) releases the reservation and moves it to Cancelled. The change is recorded under the system user. Idempotent: replaying the same decision returns 200 with the message "Budget decision already applied" and no side effects; a contradicting decision for an order already decided returns 400.
